Create the squared height term needed to compute a clinically meaningful BMI feature from numeric height data.
Age has sufficient distinct numeric values and notable outliers; quantile binning captures non-linear age effects while remaining safe and interpretable.

Engineered features include numeric and low-cardinality categorical columns (e.g., Gender, CAEC, MTRANS, CALC) with no missing values; median imputation plus standard scaling for numeric features and one-hot encoding for categoricals is a safe, leakage-free preprocessing baseline. Protected id and target columns are excluded from features.
